mapper.select: SELECT user_id, zip_code, base_address, detail_address, create_dt, update_dt FROM address_tb WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE address_tb SET zip_code = #{zipCode}, base_address = #{baseAddress}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address_tb( user_id, zip_code, base_address, detail_address) VALUES (#{userId}, #{zipCode}, #{baseAddress}, #{detailAddress})
